title: Plurai, founded by former Nexar staffers to use synthetic data and digital twins of corporate IT environments to assess AI agents, raised a $13M seed (Tim Fernholz/TechCrunch)
summary: Tim Fernholz / TechCrunch: Plurai, founded by former Nexar staffers to use synthetic data and digital twins of corporate IT environments to assess AI agents, raised a $13M seed — AI agents are all the rage, but they're not quite as capable as their purveyors would have you believe.
